name: MYDCD
recent: MyDCD Berhad 于 2026 年 11 月 19 日在 ACE Market 上市，首次公开募股（IPO）规模为 RM187.6 million。上市后，多名董事及主要股东（包括 Yew Kim Keong、Ow Yong Min Che 等）在公开市场或通过认购方式增持股份，同时也有部分股东（如 Mohd Hashim Bin Abdullah、Khairil Husni Azri 等）申报不再是大股东。公司最新季度（2026 年 9 月 30 日止）录得营收 RM178.68 million 及净利 RM25.71 million。
notable: 公司于 2026 年 11 月 19 日在 ACE Market 上市，IPO 规模为 RM187.6 million。
董事 Yew Kim Keong 于 2026 年 11 月 17 日至 20 日期间在公开市场增持公司股份。
董事 Ow Yong Min Che 于 2026 年 11 月 23 日在公开市场增持 500,000 股。
risks: 多名股东（包括 Mohd Hashim Bin Abdullah、Khairil Husni Azri Bin Mohd Hashim、Ngooi Siew Luan）申报不再是大股东。
公司上市首日股价表现平淡（subdued debut）。
earnings: 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度，公司营收为 RM178.68 million，净利为 RM25.71 million，净利率 14.4%。

recent_en: MyDCD Berhad listed on the ACE Market on 19 November 2026, with an IPO size of RM187.6 million. Following the listing, several directors and substantial shareholders (including Yew Kim Keong and Ow Yong Min Che) increased their holdings via open market purchases or subscriptions, while some shareholders (such as Mohd Hashim Bin Abdullah and Khairil Husni Azri) ceased to be substantial shareholders. For the latest quarter ended 30 September 2026, the company reported revenue of RM178.68 million and net profit of RM25.71 million.
notable_en: The company listed on the ACE Market on 19 November 2026 with an IPO size of RM187.6 million.
Director Yew Kim Keong acquired shares in the open market between 17 and 20 November 2026.
Director Ow Yong Min Che acquired 500,000 shares in the open market on 23 November 2026.
risks_en: Several shareholders (including Mohd Hashim Bin Abdullah, Khairil Husni Azri Bin Mohd Hashim and Ngooi Siew Luan) ceased to be substantial shareholders.
The stock had a subdued trading debut on the ACE Market.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 September 2026, revenue was RM178.68 million and net profit was RM25.71 million, with a net margin of 14.4%.
